locations.name: Crash Site
locations.summary: The temperate world where your life-raft went down. Breathable air, abundant biomass.

locations.name: Glacial Moon
locations.summary: A frozen, irradiated moon. Rumored deposits of fuel-grade ore beneath the regolith.

locations.name: Drifting Asteroid Field
locations.summary: A slow-tumbling belt of metal-rich rock. Hard to reach, but dense with ore.

locations.name: Infested World
locations.summary: A world overrun by a xeno hive. Accepting the purge contract pinpoints its location.

locations.name: Derelict Station
locations.summary: A long-abandoned orbital station. Its logs may hold the way home.
